title: KIZATOURS EXPERIENCE FESTIVAL 2027  | 10 YEARS ANNIVERSARY
description:
KIZATOURS EXPERIENCE 2027
10 YEARS ANNIVERSARY EDITION
12–14 MARCH 2027 | TOURS – FRANCE
👉👉 SAVE THE DATE 👈👈
✨ More than a festival. An experience.
In 2027, Kizatours celebrates 10 years of passion, dance, connection, and unforgettable memories.
For this special anniversary edition, we invite you to join us in an exceptional venue surrounded by nature: La Forêt des Arts, a unique place where dance, emotions, and human connections come together.
For one unforgettable weekend, immerse yourself in a world designed for dancers who are looking for more than workshops and parties.
Experience meaningful connections.
Experience inspiring artists.
Experience a unique atmosphere.
Experience Kizatours.
🌿 WHY KIZATOURS EXPERIENCE?
✔ Exceptional venue surrounded by nature
✔ 3 dance rooms – 3 different vibes
✔ Salsa • Bachata • Kizomba
✔ More than 20 hours of workshops
✔ International & national artists
✔ Social dance areas
✔ Shows & performances
✔ Premium and human-sized atmosphere
✔ Spaces to relax, connect and enjoy
✔ Celebration of Kizatours’ 10th anniversary
Whether you come to learn, dance, connect, relax, or simply create unforgettable memories, Kizatours Experience is designed for you.
NEW FOR 2027
📱 Kizatours Experience App
Designed to make your festival experience even more immersive and enjoyable.
✔ Access all practical information in one place
✔ Discover exclusive surprises throughout the weekend
✔ New community features designed especially for dancers
More details coming soon…
Exclusive surprises planned for 2027 !!
